**Designing for the beautiful mess of modern work**\\

Across all collections, every app feels cohesive and familiar, empowering teams through one design language.

## Shape the future of teamwork

![A large group of designers and engineers from the Atlassian Design team pose together at a group offsite.](https://atlassian.design/assets/761e54c7783e/static/group-photo-1733851949137050d70f19bcf80fc60d.jpg)

Join our global team of designers, engineers, and researchers, using elegant design to help millions of customers achieve more.
